person_scope: Person instance only; held objects and other people are not automatically included.
selection: Require exactly one person instance above threshold in each probed frame. Multiple people remain ambiguous rather than being merged or silently selecting the largest.
inputs: Three raw-image candidates selected before any new metric scores; first/middle/last frames.
isolation: Construction-only CNN family. Never consumes MobileSAM scoring masks, human scoring boxes, or DINO features/scores.
adoption_status: Not a replacement for the frozen SegFormer v2 dataset. Full-frame coverage and human review are required before a new construction protocol or scoring cohort is adopted.
